method: Whole4files manually read; pinned Git bytes verified. No desktop execution.
findings: Tabbed view owns7pane unique_ptrs; creation returns failure if any pane unavailable. New-root update resets optional visibility then forwards model changes to panes except sender.

Watcher show calls StartMonitoring, restarting prior monitor; hide stops and clears history. Permission show calls synchronous modal StartScan and sets visibility from completion result; hide alone does not explicitly clear retained rows here.

Duplicate tab visibility depends on scan option and existing root; activation sorts stored duplicate results rather than starting a fresh equality scan. Search/analytics visibility changes are presentation actions only.
Keyboard tab cycles visible panes without wrap at endpoints, then routes focus to extension list. Programmatic active-tab changes focus content when prior focus already inside container.

Extension view publishes model extension data only when types shown and root done; stopped/partial finalized root can satisfy this state. Hiding clears displayed data pointer. No disk reread or completeness evidence.
Extension synchronization selects first selected IT_FILE extension; multiple-extension selection is not aggregated here. Highlight notifications depend on extension-control focus.

Extension percentages receive physical root size while per-extension data bytes were collected from logical file sizes; interpretation needs remaining ExtensionListControl review, not assumed same denominator semantics.
limits: No UI tab/focus, monitor restart, permission cancel, extension percentage or stale-pointer runtime test.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
